name: A level 60 Primalist can switch to Mountain King
contract: Switching specialization uploads the class tree, the new specialization's identity and its signature, and
ApplyKnownEntriesUpload adds every entry of the target tab whose spell PersistentRank finds among the class's
trainer spells. Seismic Smash 300693, the Mountain King capstone entry 7498 (23 points invested in the tab),
was listed there at level 59, so the empty Mountain King build always carried the capstone and was refused
with CA_LEARN_NOT_ENOUGH_INVESTED_TE while every other specialization switched. A level 60 Primalist switches
to Wildwalker and then to Mountain King; both switches must be applied, and the capstone stays unlearned.

steps.label: CONTROL: switching to Wildwalker is applied
THE FIX: switching to Mountain King is applied
The capstone is not learned by the switch
